summary: We use ECS for auto-scaling build agents for buildkite.com. We are using [custom metrics and several Lambdas](https://github.com/buildkite/elastic-ci-stack-for-aws-ecs) for scaling the ECS service that runs our agent based on pending CI jobs. Presently when a we scale in the DesiredCount on the service, it seems like it's random which running containers get killed. It would be great to have more control over this, either a customizable timeframe to wait for containers to stop after being signaled or something similar to [EC2 Lifecycle Hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguid
title: [ECS] [request]: Control which containers are terminated on scale in
